Introduction

My name is Shumaila Junejo, and I am a third-year M.A. student. I completed an 82-hour internship at Government Degree College, Qasimabad, Hyderabad, as part of my academic learning. During the first two to three days, I observed senior teachers and learned their teaching methods and classroom management techniques. After that, I started performing my assigned duties independently.

During my internship, I communicated with students, participated in classroom activities, managed classrooms, and assisted with tests. I also performed invigilation duties, including checking seat numbers, distributing question papers and answer sheets, taking attendance, supervising students, and collecting and arranging answer sheets. This internship improved my practical knowledge, communication skills, and confidence and helped me prepare for my future teaching career.

2

Internship Objectives

The main objective of my 82-hour internship at Government Degree College, Qasimabad, Hyderabad, was to gain practical experience and understand how teaching takes place in a real classroom. During this internship, I had the opportunity to observe senior teachers, participate in teaching activities, and perform examination duties. This experience helped me understand the responsibilities of a teacher and prepare for my future teaching career.

My main objectives were:

  1. To observe senior teachers and learn their teaching methods.
  2. To gain practical experience by participating in teaching activities.
  3. To learn how to manage classrooms and maintain discipline.
  4. To improve my communication skills and interact with students effectively.
  5. To learn how to engage students and encourage their participation.
  6. To understand how university knowledge can be applied in a real educational environment.
  7. To learn about tests, invigilation duties, and examination management.
  8. To identify my weaknesses, improve my teaching skills, and build confidence for my future career.

Overall, my aim was to learn through observation and practice, understand the teaching profession, and develop the skills needed to become a good teacher.
